data.name: Rose
data.short_meaning: Rose is a name derived from the Hebrew word 'Rosh', which means 'head'. It can also be linked to the Greek and Latin words 'Ros', meaning 'dew of the rose' and 'rose flower' respectively.
data.long_meaning: The name Rose has a rich history in Christianity, rooted in both the Old and New Testaments. In the Old Testament, the name Rose is associated with the Hebrew word 'Rosh', which means 'head'. This name is also linked to the Greek and Latin words 'Ros', meaning 'dew of the rose' and 'rose flower' respectively. In the New Testament, the name Rose is symbolic of the resurrection of Christ, as a rose blooms after winter's end, and represents the Virgin Mary and her purity. Additionally, the name Rose is associated with the martyr Rose of Limos, who was believed to have a rose bush grow up around her grave.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rose symbolizes new beginnings, resurrection, and the beauty of the Virgin Mary.
data.numerology_meaning: Rose is a 9 Life Path Number, symbolizing humanitarianism, altruism, and creativity.
